text:
CA firms: the busiest weeks of the year are spent chasing documents, not doing the work.

A system that fixes most of it, set up before January:

1. One checklist per client type (salaried, business, NRI) and one upload link
2. An automatic WhatsApp every 5 days listing only the PENDING documents for that client
3. One status sheet: client, pending items, due date, with a morning summary to the team

The partner stops being the reminder service. Juniors stop guessing who to call. Clients like it because they see exactly what is missing.

Want this set up for your firm before tax season? Comment "AUDIT" and I'll send a 3-minute review of how you collect documents today.

#charteredaccountant #taxseason #practicemanagement
